Done! I've set up auto-start for your sync script. Here's what I configured:

**Setup created:**
- **Batch wrapper** — `scripts/autostart.bat` runs the PowerShell script with proper execution policy
- **Startup shortcut** — Added to your Windows Startup folder
- **Auto-launch** — The sync runs minimized every time you log in

The sync script will now start automatically without requiring manual launch. The shortcut is in your Startup folder at `%APPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup\Sync AutoStart.lnk`.

To verify it's working after your next reboot, check the `data/feed.log` file to confirm the sync ran.
